title: The Moon Is Slowly Leaving Us
description:
Laser reflectors left by the Apollo missions show that the Moon's distance from Earth is increasing, at roughly the rate at which human fingernails grow. As the Moon drifts away, Earth's rotation slows and Earth's day lengthens by about 17 microseconds every year. In five billion years the Moon will orbit 40% further away.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Moon'.

Would you rather have a closer or farther Moon? Tell us in the comments.
